instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, full shot. On a rocky coastal shoreline under an overcast sky, the man in the light blue shirt (R1) stands barefoot on the left, looking to the right. Beside him on the right, the blonde woman in the pink floral dress (R2) stands looking forward, holding her hair with her left hand as the wind blows her dress. They stand close together on the uneven rocks. The lighting is soft and diffused, highlighting the vibrant pink of the dress against the muted gray rocks and sea.
